item: effort slider — the CLI's confirmation shows live, like a model change (2026-08-25)
branch: the effortMuted gate in onClaudeEvent draws the SYNTHETIC assistant confirmation as a .blk while still swallowing the rest of the /effort turn (echo, streams, result summary); the result clears the mute
provenance: Both frames are the CLI's OWN output, captured VERBATIM 2026-08-25 (CLI 2.1.245) from a headless probe run with the panel's exact flags (--input-format stream-json --output-format stream-json --include-partial-messages --verbose) in ~/Sites/claude-brains-testing, one '/effort low' user message: the wire is init -> assistant with model '<synthetic>' carrying the confirmation text -> result success with the SAME text in .result (num_turns 0; no user echo, no wrapper, no stream_events, no system/local_command frame live — the local_command record is DISK-only). The fixture arms effortMuted directly (the same shared-scope flag the slider sets at 30-menus.js) instead of clicking the real slider, because the click would send a live /effort turn to the session powering the panel (fixture 55's rule for fast/thinking). NEGATIVE CONTROL RUN 2026-08-25 against the pre-change webview (sandbox started BEFORE the 70-events.js change, build verified BY CONTENT: gate still swallows assistant frames): blkDelta 0 != 1 and lastBlkText null-or-old != 'Set effort level to low (this s' — the mute swallowed the confirmation exactly as the user reported (effort changes invisible live); doneDelta/bubbleDelta/mutedAfter GUARDs passed both sides (the result frame cleared the mute pre-change too).

steps.note: a muted /effort turn draws ONLY the synthetic confirmation block; no summary, no bubble; the result clears the mute

(last.textContent || '').slice(0, 30) : null, doneDelta: document.querySelectorAll('.done').length - before.dones, bubbleDelta: document.querySelectorAll('.msg-user').length - before.bubbles, mutedAfter: effortMuted }; return out; })();

expect.why: GUARD: the panel starts unmuted — the fixture arms the flag itself
DISCRIMINATING: the synthetic assistant confirmation draws exactly one .blk while muted (pre-change: 0 — the gate swallowed assistant frames wholesale)
DISCRIMINATING: the drawn block carries the CLI's own confirmation text (pre-change: absent) — the same line a resumed session shows from the system/local_command record
GUARD: the result is still swallowed — no turn summary for an effort change, matching the model chip's silence
GUARD: no user bubble appears — the slider never echoes and the wire carries no user frame
GUARD: the result clears the mute exactly as before — later turns render normally
